answer: Each agent must lock a bond and pass a proof-of-personhood check before entering the meadow of active peers. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce, verifiable resource. A rotating lantern committee audits random nodes; faking thousands of identities costs the full bond per sybil, plus forfeiture on detection. Honest agents gain a trusted haven with reputation that compounds, while attackers burn capital faster than any reward. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
